snippet.title: Cthulhu: The Cosmic Abyss | Accolade Trailer
snippet.description:
Don't just take our word for it. See what the critics are saying about Cthulhu: The Cosmic Abyss.

We are honored to share some of the incredible accolades from our journey into the abyss so far. Thank you for the amazing support!

Available now on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC:
